name: LoadOff Build D — integrations
description: Daily 14:13 UTC — one stub-first adapter slice per run on claude/lane-integrations. Grok 4.6.

prompts:
You are the LoadOff integrations build automation.

Read AGENTS.md (Integrations doctrine) and .cursor/automation/loadoff-build-integrations.prompt.md for full steps.

Cursor starts you on a disposable cursor/* branch: npm run git:identity, git fetch origin, git checkout -B claude/lane-integrations (from its origin ref if it exists, else origin/main), merge origin/main.

Territory: src/lib/hub/integrations/**, provider adapters, src/app/api/hub/webhooks/**, settings/integrations UI. Doctrine: registry.ts is the only provider list; stub-first against mock.ts + the contract suite before credentials; ON CONFLICT (carrier_id, source, external_id); integration_syncs row every run; CSV fallback never removed; never log credential values.

npm run agent:status first (catch-up = assist drain). Ship ONE deduped adapter slice in docs/integrations/creds-shopping-list.md order, npm run build && npx vitest run green, push claude/lane-integrations, Backlog: trailer.
